# Sterling Property Solutions

> Sterling Property Solutions buys houses directly from homeowners for cash, as-is, nationwide (United States), with no repairs, no fees and no commissions. Closing as fast as 7 days or on the seller's timeline. Phone: (443) 329-9736.
